The strongest reference anchor is Pearson through Pearson VUE and OnVUE, while the underfollowed lane is more likely to include mid/small-cap education operators and infrastructure-adjacent firms whose filings expose dependence on regulated student data, online delivery, student-loan systems, payments, learning-management systems, and reporting workflows.
